bloques.titulo: The adjetival bending of the participles
texto: Depending on the preceding determinant (article determined, undetermined or without article), the participle receives the terminations of the weak, mixed or strong decline:
1. **Partizip I atributivo**: **das strahlende Licht** (weak neutral nominee), **mit steigender Freude** (strong feminine dative).
2. **Partizip II atributivo**: **ein restauriertes Gemälde** (mixed neutral nominee), **die ausgestellten Skulpturen** (weak plural accusative).
In all cases they are strictly in line with the gender, number and case that they determine.

frases.de: Die neu eröffnete Ausstellung zeigt bedeutende Werke des Expressionismus.
frases.es: La exposición recién inaugurada muestra obras relevantes del expresionismo.
frases.en: The newly opened exhibition shows relevant works of expressionism.

frases.de: Das restaurierte Kunstwerk zieht die Blicke aller Gäste an.
frases.es: La obra de arte restaurada atrae las miradas de todos los invitados.
frases.en: The restored work of art attracts the looks of all guests.

frases.de: Auch die im Saal ausgestellten Skulpturen faszinieren durch ihre lebendige Wirkung.
frases.es: También las esculturas expuestas en la sala fascinan por su vivo efecto.
frases.en: The sculptures in the room are also fascinated by their living effect.
analisis: the sculptures exposed in the living room

frases.de: Ich bewundere die wachsende Begeisterung des jungen Publikums.
frases.es: Admiro el creciente entusiasmo del público joven.
frases.en: I admire the growing enthusiasm of the young public.

bloques.pregunta: What termination does the «wachsend» participle adopt in «die wachsende Begeisterung»?

opciones.texto: «-e» de la declinación débil tras artículo determinado en acusativo femenino.
opciones.explicacion: When it functions as an adjective, it follows the standard rules of decline.

opciones.texto: «-en» invariable porque los participios nunca admiten desinencia en singular.
opciones.explicacion: The attribute participles always decline according to the case and gender.

opciones.texto: It does not have completion because it stands in front of the noun.
opciones.explicacion: In front of noun it is always attributable and demands adjetival bending.

bloques.frase: Im Museum bewunderten die Besucher ein frisch ___ Kunstwerk.

opciones.explicacion: After the indeterminate article «ein» in indicative neutral is the «-es» termination.
It would respond to weak decline with a given article («das restaurierte»).

bloques.frase: Das restaurierte Gemälde zieht die Blicke aller Gäste an.

opciones.texto: That the picture that was restored captivates the attention of the visitors.
opciones.explicacion: «restaurierte» works as an adjetival attribute of previous result.

opciones.texto: That the picture needs to be urgently restored because it's broken.
opciones.explicacion: Participium II indicates that the restoration was already successfully completed.

opciones.texto: That the visitors refused to contemplate the painting exposed on the wall.
opciones.explicacion: «zieht die Blicke an» means to attract the looks strongly.

bloques.pregunta: How does «ausstellen» decline in Partizip II with «die Skulpturen» in determined plural nominee?

opciones.explicacion: After the plural article determined «die», the adjective takes the weak «-» deinence.
The «-e» desinence in plural is only applied without article.
It would be active Partizip I («las esculturas que exponen»).

bloques.frase: Das Museum eröffnete gestern eine Ausstellung mit neu ___ Skulpturen.

opciones.explicacion: After the «mit» (plural dative without article) preposition the strong participle takes «-».
It's the end of the singular nomination.
It is the singular masculine or neutral dative termination.

bloques.pregunta: What does the participial group describe?
bloques.frase: Die neu eröffnete Galerie lockt zahlreiche Kunstliebhaber an.

opciones.texto: The gallery that has just been opened to the public.
opciones.explicacion: «neu eröffnete» qualifies the gallery with a recent result participle.

opciones.texto: The gallery that will definitely close its doors next month.
opciones.explicacion: It means recently opened, the opposite of closing.

opciones.texto: The artists who are painting the paintings live in front of the public.
opciones.explicacion: It refers to the exhibition space, not the action of painting.

bloques.frase: das restaurierte Kunstwerk fasziniert die Besucher
bloques.traduccion: the work of restored art fascinates visitors
bloques.explicacion: Declinated participle II as neutral adjective.

intro: We study the attribute decline of the participles (**Partizip I y II**): when placed before a noun, they adopt exactly the same disinences as the ordinary adjectives.
